updates.title: Codec support, standalone activities, Tempo Web, and workflow payloads
updates.description: This update adds codec server support for encrypted Temporal payloads, read-only standalone activity browsing, a deployable Tempo Web experience, and clearer workflow payload visibility.
notes: Added codec settings and codec server decoding for encrypted workflow, activity, query, memo, and standalone activity payloads
Added a Standalone Activities section with list, count, pagination, and detail screens scoped to standalone activity fields
Added Tempo Web deployment support with Kubernetes manifests, Argo CD GitOps deployment, and a browser-compatible gRPC-Web proxy
Added workflow input and workflow output payloads to the workflow details Summary tab
Improved timeline navigation on web so mouse wheel scrolling works with the horizontal timeline
Improved the Task Queues screen with a responsive search card, clearer Workflow/Activity selector, and better mobile button layout

updates.title: Tempo 1.0.1 - Namespace dropdown fix
updates.description: This update fixes a bug from the initial App Store release that prevented the namespaces dropdown from working as expected.
notes: Fixed a bug preventing the namespaces dropdown from working as expected

updates.title: Tempo 1.0 - Initial Release
updates.description: Welcome to Tempo 1.0! The first official release of Tempo.
